summary: Ryan Wells and Ricky Colton, both of Delta, drove a privately owned 15,000-lb sno-cat onto the ice at Island Lake around 1 AM Sunday and broke through; reported overdue at Grand Mesa Lodge that morning; Delta County SAR searched and found no evidence either man had gotten out; bodies recovered from the lake in August 2019
responding_agency: Delta County Search and Rescue / Delta County Sheriff's Office
notes: Grand Mesa Lodge owner warned Wells against taking the sno-cat onto the ice the night before; two lodge companions (Dustin Gray, Kandi Casaus) were located safe; 15,000-lb sno-cat raised by divers in Sept 2020 (Adventures With Purpose); resolves the run-159 Delta County pending lead
